subject.title: Bug: preflight (budget-triggered) compaction hard-capped at ~60s, ignores compaction.timeoutSeconds

question: For required preflight compaction, should lifecycle `TimeoutError` from the reply operation be filtered while preserving explicit stop/restart cancellation, or should preflight receive no reply abort signal at all?
rationale: Current main proves the raw reply signal is still wired into preflight compaction, but the permanent cancellation contract affects session-state and availability behavior and should be chosen by maintainers before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Filter lifecycle timeout only
options.body: Adopt the linked PR shape so explicit abort/restart still cancels preflight while lifecycle timeout no longer caps compaction below `compaction.timeoutSeconds`.

options.title: Drop reply abort for preflight
options.body: Make compaction timeout the only owner for required preflight work, accepting slower response to explicit user/restart cancellation.

options.title: Add an opt-out config gate
options.body: Add a new preflight-disable knob, but this expands config surface and does not fix the default cancellation race by itself.

recommendation.title: Filter lifecycle timeout only
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked PR shape so explicit abort/restart still cancels preflight while lifecycle timeout no longer caps compaction below `compaction.timeoutSeconds`.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history signal for the preflight compaction function; final behavior choice may still need maintainer sponsorship.
